## Constant and field details

<a id="TweenPaths-constant-LINEAR"></a>

### LINEAR

`LinearTweenPath LINEAR` 

Joins the points with straight segments: the motion changes direction sharply at each waypoint.

<a id="TweenPaths-constant-CATMULL_ROM"></a>

### CATMULL_ROM

`CatmullRomTweenPath CATMULL_ROM` 

Joins the points with a smooth curve that passes through each of them; the default path of a tween.
